# `oaap app purge`

delete data left behind by a removed instance.

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app purge [--yes] name
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | -- |
| `--yes` | carry it out after reading what is deleted |
